name: FICTURN
format: short finished pre-authored fiction in an inline reader
discovery_intents: short story to read in ChatGPT

stories.title: The Safehouse Rule
stories.hook: A coastal safehouse. A sealed phone. A woman running from the past. A man who might be the only one keeping her alive.

stories.title: Room 713
stories.hook: The hotel has six floors. Your phone receives a message from room 713 anyway.

stories.title: The Last Reply
stories.hook: A near-future story about digital doubles, identity and what remains of a person when the replica answers back.

example_prompts: Give me a short story I can read in five minutes
I want a romantic suspense story
Give me something eerie and short
Show me a near-future AI thriller
